prompts.master:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production character artwork for a 2D animated presenter. Use the attached APPROVED painted Evan visual-development sheet as the exact identity and art-direction reference. Match the full-bodied real young man's broad face, natural full lips, black wayfarer sunglasses, dark curly tousled hair, subtle short chin/jaw stubble, navy shirt and black tie. Preserve the sophisticated painted 2D illustration, contour drawing, natural facial anatomy and subtle brush texture. Do NOT simplify into geometric cartoon shapes.
Create ONE single large full character asset from top of hair to mid-thigh, facing camera in a mild three-quarter view, on a genuinely transparent background, no paper, no drop shadow. Character stands upright and balanced, face toward viewer, head nearly vertical without dramatic tilt. Mouth neutral gently closed, calm approachable face. Navy fitted long-sleeved collared shirt, loose black tie, black belt and trousers. Both arms fully out of pockets, held comfortably 25 degrees away from the torso with elbows gently bent, palms relaxed open forward; both hands completely visible with exactly five anatomically natural fingers. This is an animation setup pose, not a hero poster. Broad shoulders and realistic athletic proportions. BOTH upper arms, elbow bends, cuffs and hands must be distinct and clear, unobscured by torso or each other. Keep fabric folds elegant and controlled, avoid very fine noise. Large enough face for a closeup. Complete uncropped silhouette with ample clear margin. High-resolution master illustration, no text, no diagrams, no rig labels, no duplicate figures, no decorative objects. The result must look like another drawing of the same approved Evan, with at least the same painting quality.
prompts.cutoutAttempt: Edit this Evan character master illustration. Change ONLY background treatment: remove EVERY trace of the painted dark backdrop, navy haze, orange hand glows and all surrounding shadows. The entire space outside the actual man must be 100% transparent with clean antialiased silhouette edges. No halo, rim glow or colored mist. Preserve the character's face, lips, hair, sunglasses, exact pose, anatomy, hands, clothing and brushwork unchanged. Keep the same canvas and same complete character. This is a clean transparent production cutout, not a dramatic portrait.
prompts.chromaPlate: Edit the attached Evan master illustration. Preserve the man exactly: same face, hair, sunglasses, pose, hands, clothes and painted detail. Replace ALL background pixels and ALL glows/haze outside his silhouette with a perfectly uniform solid bright magenta #FF00FF. This includes the gaps between arms and torso, outside fingers, either side of legs, and around hair. NO gradient, NO glow, NO black backdrop, NO environmental shadows, NO magenta reflected light on the character. Character edges should be clean and antialiased into the magenta. Keep the canvas and position exactly the same. This is a production chroma-key plate; uniform magenta backdrop is essential. Do not redraw or change the man's identity or pose.
prompts.facialAtlas:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create production facial pose artwork of the SAME Evan from the attached APPROVED painted character sheet. Identity and painting style locked: broad youthful face, full natural lips, short subtle stubble, thick tousled dark hair, black wayfarer sunglasses, navy shirt collar. Sophisticated warm painted 2D illustration, natural anatomy and elegant contours; NOT generic angular cartoon, not plastic 3D. This is new artwork, not a diagram.
A large SQUARE 3x3 evenly spaced grid of NINE complete isolated head-and-neck portraits, each the identical size and three-quarter camera orientation, head upright, looking toward viewer. Each panel must contain complete uncropped hair, face, chin and short neck ending in a navy shirt collar. Perfectly consistent hairstyle, sunglasses, nose, ears and head lighting across all nine. Only mouth/jaw/cheek tension changes. Plain completely uniform bright magenta (#FF00FF) backdrop in every panel and all gutters, no gradients, no lighting spill, no shadows on background. Do not put magenta on character.
Expressions in row-major order:
1 neutral relaxed lips CLOSED, natural fullness and cupid's bow.
2 MBP lips firmly CLOSED with gentle lip compression, cheeks relaxed.
3 teeth slightly apart in conversational E/EE, narrow oral opening, natural lips.
4 medium AH, integrated lowered jaw, natural upper teeth arch, tongue inside.
5 wide AH stressed vowel, comfortably lowered jaw with believable cheeks/chin, not screaming.
6 rounded O, distinctly rounded full lips and moderately open round cavity.
7 pursed OO/U, small rounded opening, full lips project naturally.
8 FV contact, UPPER front teeth just touching LOWER lip, upper lip lifted, no open vowel.
9 L sound, slightly open mouth with visible tongue tip raised behind upper teeth.
No labels or text. No free-floating mouth stickers. Each expression must be a fully painted believable face with the facial structure responding to the sound. Consistency matters as much as rendering quality. Leave clear margins between every portrait, nothing overlapping. Request very high resolution so individual portraits remain useful.
prompts.torso: Edit this exact production character plate to create a BODY-ONLY hidden-surface animation layer. Keep the exact 1024x1536 canvas and body placement. Preserve navy shirt torso, collar, black tie, belt, trousers, their current silhouette and painted texture. Remove the entire head/hair/face above the neck and remove both arms from their shoulder joints, including all sleeves and hands; fill removed areas with the same perfectly flat #FF00FF magenta background. Retain the exposed NECK above the collar so a separately animated head can overlap it. At each shoulder create a natural rounded shirt-covered shoulder cap UNDER where a separate upper arm will overlap. Paint the missing small side-of-shirt surfaces behind the arms to make a complete torso layer. Do not leave arm stubs or hands. Do not move, scale, rotate or redesign the torso, tie, collar, belt or trousers. This is an isolated layer for a 2D puppet, not a finished person. Only head and both arms disappear. Same painted illustration quality, no text, no grid, no shadows or gradients on backdrop.
